info.description:
Complete API test suite covering authentication, project management, data ingestion, device management, and EMQX webhooks.

**Run order:** Execute folders top-to-bottom. Variables are set automatically by test scripts.

**Timeliness:** Every request asserts response time < 500 ms.

**Auth:** Folder 1 (Auth) sets `access_token` and `refresh_token`. Folder 3 (API Keys) sets `api_key_full`. Ingest requests use the API key; all other protected requests use the JWT.
